rca of the issue: Reset-sample RCA: endpoint deletes sample tests/inspections first (`delete_many(sample=True)`), then checks whether any records remain. If a real record exists, endpoint returns 400 but sample data is already deleted. Repro: choose sample unit stage=5 with sample inspection; create real inspection via /units/{id}/inspections; call /units/{id}/reset-sample -> 400 and sample inspection count decreases. Mitigation: perform real-record existence check before any delete, or wrap check+delete+update in transaction.
